adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the import path changes from `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), raw: "[[Permalink](...)]")` to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` performs an HTTP fetch (`open(url).read`) and ultimately calls `PostCreator` without passing `created_at`, so imported topics/posts will get the current timestamp instead of the thread’s original `created_at` (data correctness loss). It also no longer uses the explicit permalink-only body; instead it imports readability-extracted HTML and appends an 'Imported from' link, which is a silent behavioral/contract change for the CLI output/content.
